trans.sense: round container of lesser capacity than a barrel
round container of lesser capacity than a barrel

examples.text: He bore on his shoulder a stout keg, that seemed full of liquor, and made signs for Rip to approach and assist him with his load.
examples.ref: 1819 June 23, Geoffrey Crayon [pseudonym; Washington Irving], “Rip Van Winkle”, in The Sketch Book of Geoffrey Crayon, Gent., number I, New York, N.Y.: […] C[ornelius] S. Van Winkle, […], →OCLC, page 72:

glosses: A round, traditionally wooden container of lesser capacity than a barrel, often used to store beer.
